name: Iris

attacks.label: Guiding Bolt
attacks.note: Range 120ft. On hit: next attack vs target has advantage. Free cast 2/LR (Star Map).

attacks.label: Starry Archer
attacks.note: Bonus action. Range 60ft. Requires Starry Form active.

attacks.label: Primal Savagery
attacks.note: Melee spell attack. S component only.

attacks.label: Produce Flame
attacks.note: Cantrip. Range 30ft. Or hold for light (10ft bright / 10ft dim).

attacks.label: Guidance
attacks.note: Cantrip. Touch, conc 1min. Target adds this roll to one ability check before spell ends.

attacks.label: Starry Chalice
attacks.note: Requires Chalice form active. When casting a healing spell, one creature within 30ft regains this HP.

attacks.label: Healing Word
attacks.note: BA, 60ft, verbal only. +1d4 per slot above 1st.

attacks.label: Thunderwave
attacks.on_fail: pushed 10ft on fail; half damage on success
attacks.note: 15ft cube from self. L1. +1d8 per slot above 1st.

attacks.label: Entangle
attacks.note: STR DC13 save or restrained while plants persist. 20ft square, 90ft range. Conc 1min. L1.

attacks.label: Faerie Fire
attacks.note: DEX DC13 save or outlined in light. Attacks vs outlined have advantage. 20ft cube, 60ft. Conc 1min. L1.

background_story: Spartan heritage with Carthaginian origin. Adopted family is Carthaginian. Carries two worlds: Spartan discipline and austerity from upbringing, Carthaginian mercantile culture from adopted kin. Shadar-kai shadow-marking is a third inheritance she did not choose.
notes: Alignment unknown. Shadar-kai: Darkvision 60ft, Necrotic Resistance, Immunity magical sleep, Fey Ancestry (adv saves vs charmed / adv to avoid+end charmed), Keen Senses (Perception prof), Trance (long rest in 4h). Blessing of Raven Queen: BA teleport 30ft to unoccupied space seen 2x/LR; on teleport gain resistance all damage until next turn start. Creature type Humanoid+Elf. Druid: Wild Shape 2/SR (2nd CR 1/4 no fly/swim; 4th CR 1/2; 8th CR 1). Spellcasting WIS DC13 Atk+5. Star Map: Guiding Bolt always prepared+free cast (2/LR). Starry Form (BA Wild Shape use): Archer (BA ranged +5 1d8+3 radiant 60ft), Chalice (cast healing spell → creature 30ft regains 1d8+3), Dragon (INT/WIS check or concentration save roll 9or lower treat as 10). Resistances: Necrotic. Immunities: magical sleep. Equipment: Galea Attica, Lorica Squamata, Dagger+Longbow, Druidic Focus. Passive Perception 15, Passive Insight 15.
